name: DOOMFLY
description: The neurons of the public DOOMFLY demo (github.com/nftechie/doomfly, MIT): the turn is DNp20 right minus left, the walk is DNpe017. They are not the biology of walking and turning (the authors say so); they are the neurons that answer to the picture in this model. Added for the objects that come at the fly (the looming): DNa02 (the fast turn: right minus left, twice the weight) and the giant fiber DNp01 (a single spike is a shot). The gains and the thresholds are ours.
